blocks.text: Your Tampa CPA Explains What a GSA Schedule Can Mean For Your Business

A U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Schedule provides vendors access to a wide variety of government-controlled purchases of products and services from commercial firms. Also known as Federal Supply Schedules or Multiple Award Schedules, a GSA Schedule gives your company an opportunity to compete for long-term government contracts and can become a reliable source of income over the long haul.

A [Tampa CPA](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help you determine whether a GSA Schedule is the right choice for your business. Since 1984, Reliance has performed accounting and consulting services for hundreds of small businesses in the Tampa Bay area and beyond. Our goal is help you find the path to prosperity and stay on it indefinitely.
